tagline: Kowa双镜头反光相机，1954 年发布
description: Kowa于1954年推出的双镜头反光相机。配备Prominar 1:3.5 f=75mm, coated.。快门速度Seikosha-Rapid leafshutter. Speeds 1 to 1/500 sec. and B.。使用12 exposures of 6 x 6 cm on 120 type rollfilm.。

specs.胶片/画幅: 12 exposures of 6 x 6 cm on 120 type rollfilm.
specs.快门: Seikosha-Rapid leafshutter. Speeds 1 to 1/500 sec. and B.
specs.闪光灯: Sync socket on frontpanel. X synchronization
specs.英文简介: The Kalloflex Automat was a twin-lens reflex produced by Kowa Optical Works, in two versions beginning in 1954.
